_note: Ratings are subjective (1-10), written Oct 2026 from career results. Edit freely. Keyed by ESPN team abbreviation; coach name is checked against ESPN live data and flagged if it changes.

ATL.name: Quin Snyder
accolades: Built Utah into the West's No. 1 seed (2021)
good: Elite offensive system design, lots of movement

BOS.name: Joe Mazzulla
accolades: Youngest coach to win a title since Bill Russell
bad: Offense can get stuck in iso-heavy stretches

NO.name: Jamahl Mosley
accolades: Turned Orlando into a top-5 defense
Led Magic back to the playoffs
bad: Offenses have ranked near the bottom of the league
First season with a new team

CHI.name: Tiago Splitter
accolades: NBA champion as a player (2014 Spurs)
good: Spurs-style ball movement and player development

CLE.name: Kenny Atkinson
good: Fast, spaced offense that boosted Cleveland's scoring
bad: Playoff results haven't matched regular-season dominance

DAL.name: Dusty May
accolades: Led Florida Atlantic to the 2023 Final Four
Took Michigan deep into the NCAA tournament
bad: College-to-NBA coaching jumps have a mixed history

DEN.name: David Adelman
accolades: Longtime Nuggets assistant on the 2023 title team
Took over in 2025 and kept Denver a contender
good: Continuity: knows the Jokic system inside out

DET.name: J.B. Bickerstaff
accolades: Led one of the biggest turnarounds in NBA history with Detroit (2024-25)
bad: Half-court offense can bog down in the playoffs

GS.name: Steve Kerr
good: Motion offense and elite in-game adjustments
bad: Rotations get shaky with thin, aging rosters
Young player development has been criticized

HOU.name: Ime Udoka
accolades: Took Boston to the 2022 NBA Finals as a rookie coach
Turned Houston into a top seed in the West
good: Elite defensive coach, physical and switch-heavy

IND.name: Rick Carlisle
good: One of the best play-callers ever
Fast pace, great at adjusting mid-series
bad: Results swing a lot with roster health

LAC.name: Tyronn Lue
accolades: 2016 NBA champion (Cleveland, came back from 3-1 down)
Known as an elite playoff adjuster
good: Best in the league at adjusting between playoff games
bad: Regular season can feel like it's on cruise control

LAL.name: JJ Redick
accolades: Won 50 games in his first season as a head coach (2024-25)

MIA.name: Erik Spoelstra
good: Best schemer in the league, especially zone defense
bad: Roster talent sometimes limits the ceiling

MIL.name: Taylor Jenkins
accolades: Led Memphis to the No. 2 seed (2022)
good: Fast pace and strong player development

MIN.name: Chris Finch
good: Built an elite defense in Minnesota
bad: Teams can lose focus against weaker opponents

BKN.name: Jordi Fernandez
accolades: Coached Canada to bronze at the 2023 World Cup
good: Gets maximum effort from rebuilding rosters
bad: Roster has been rebuilding, so the win-loss record is limited

NY.name: Mike Brown
accolades: Coach of the reigning champion Knicks (2026)
good: Gets teams over the hump fast
bad: Has a history of tense relationships late in tenures

PHI.name: Nick Nurse
bad: Playing big minutes has worn down stars

PHX.name: Jordan Ott
bad: First-time head coach with a short record

POR.name: Micah Nori
accolades: Interim and lead assistant work in Minnesota

SA.name: Mitch Johnson
accolades: Coached San Antonio to the 2026 Finals
bad: Still a young coach; rotations were inconsistent in the Finals

OKC.name: Mark Daigneault
bad: Offense can lean too much on SGA late in games

UTAH.name: Will Hardy
accolades: Spurs assistant on the 2014 title team
bad: Rebuilding roster, so the record is poor
Defense has ranked near the bottom

MEM.name: Tuomas Iisalo
accolades: Multiple German league titles and coach of the year awards

CHA.name: Charles Lee
good: Builds structure in a young team
bad: Record limited by roster and injuries
